verdict.rationale: Runway documents Workflows, node-graph pipelines published as "private, versioned endpoints", so its own automations carry versions. That one thin mention is the only evidence, and nothing covers reviewing changes or rolling back to a prior version. Missing for 10: documented review/diff of workflow versions, documented rollback or pinning to prior versions, version history UI or API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: Workflows: node-graph pipelines built in the Runway app and published as private, versioned endpoints
